meta.title: DSH Session Deletion
meta.description: Immediate session deletion and orphan attachment cleanup for DSH.

messages.delete.title: Delete this session?
messages.delete.description: This session will be permanently removed, while saved files and attachments remain unaffected. To free up storage space, go to "More" → "Free Up Space" in the left sidebar.
messages.delete.descriptionWithChildren: This session and its {count} linked subagent(s) will be permanently removed, while saved files and attachments remain unaffected. To free up storage space, go to "More" → "Free Up Space" in the left sidebar.
messages.gc.title: Clean up orphaned attachments and cache?
messages.gc.description: Unlinked local attachments and temporary image cache will be removed to free up space. Make sure all other sessions are idle during cleanup.
messages.gc.busy: Cleaning up orphaned attachments and cache…
messages.gc.success: Cleaned up {count} orphaned attachment and cache file(s).
messages.recovery.pending: Cleanup incomplete; it will resume automatically on next launch
messages.error.publicationBlocked: Session cleanup is in progress. Please try submitting input or background actions again later.
messages.error.cleanupBusy: Another cleanup is already in progress. Please try again later.
messages.error.publicationTimeout: Message submissions or attachment operations are still in progress. Please try again later.
messages.error.sessionLocked: This session is being deleted or has already been deleted and can no longer accept input.
messages.error.sessionReopen: This session is already in the deletion process and cannot be reopened.
messages.error.sizeChanged: Sessions or attachments have changed. Please reopen the menu to recalculate size.
messages.error.guardUnavailable: Recovery monitor is unavailable. Please restart DSH.
messages.error.otherHost: Another DSH process is using the same directory. Please close it first.
messages.error.pendingDeletion: An incomplete session deletion is pending. Please restart DSH to recover.
messages.error.imageCacheBusy: Image cache is still being generated. Please try again later.
messages.error.pendingCleanup: An incomplete cleanup is pending. Please restart DSH to recover.
messages.error.sessionChanged: The session has changed. Please confirm again.
messages.error.familyChanged: The subagent group has changed. Please confirm again.
messages.error.stopTimeout: Session did not stop within 30 seconds; deletion was canceled. Cleanup may still be in progress.
messages.error.stopIncomplete: Could not confirm session cleanup; deletion was canceled.
messages.error.confirmGc: Explicit confirmation is required to clean up orphaned attachments and cache.
messages.error.sessionMissing: The session does not exist or has already been deleted.
messages.error.mainSessionRequired: Please delete from the main session to include all subagents.
messages.error.confirmDeletion: Explicit confirmation is required for permanent deletion.
messages.error.previewExpired: Confirmation expired. Please reopen the delete dialog.
messages.error.previewChanged: The session or subagents have changed. Please confirm again.
messages.activity.unsaved: Unsaved blank sessions have no logs to delete; please restart to clean up blank subagents
messages.activity.operations: Message submissions or session operations are still in progress
messages.activity.globalAgentBusy: An AI agent is still running or awaiting input; wait until all are idle before cleaning up attachments
messages.activity.targetAgentBusy: Target session or subagent is still running or awaiting input
messages.activity.missingHandle: Missing full lifecycle handle; please restart DSH
messages.activity.maintenance: Background session maintenance has not finished yet
messages.activity.terminal: Interactive terminal is still open; please close it first
messages.activity.residentSession: A resident session cannot be safely released
messages.activity.nativeBusy: Official archive still has active tasks: {kind}
messages.activity.nativeBusyUnknown: Official archive still has active tasks: background task
messages.activity.unconfirmed: Unable to confirm that all background activities have finished
messages.error.gcPendingSessions: Finish pending session deletions before GC
messages.error.incompatibleDsh: Session Deletion supports DSH {supported}; found {found}. Review before upgrading.
messages.error.guardStartTimeout: Session Deletion guard startup timed out
messages.error.otherProcessCleanup: Another DSH process is using this home; cleanup deferred
messages.error.activeWriterCleanup: A session still has a live writer; cleanup deferred
messages.error.homeBusyAtStartup: Another DSH host or cleanup owns this home; close it before starting DSH
messages.error.defaultSessionRoot: Session Deletion requires the default JSONL session root
messages.error.unsupportedPlatform: Session Deletion supports Linux and Windows only
messages.error.sameUserInspection: Cannot inspect a same-user process; cleanup deferred
messages.error.driveCwd: Cannot resolve target drive cwd; cleanup deferred
messages.error.projectionCacheDelete: Projection cache deletion capability is missing
messages.error.liveStoresRetained: Session did not leave its live stores
messages.error.activeSessionWriter: A session writer is still active
